sections.title: Üldplaneering
sections.body: Comprehensive (municipal) plan – strategic land use planning at municipal level.

sections.title: Keskkonnamõju strateegiline hindamine
sections.body: Strategic environmental assessment mandatory for comprehensive plans.

sections.title: Avalikustamine
sections.body: Public display of comprehensive plan – minimum 30 days.

sections.title: Üldplaneeringu ülevaatamine
sections.body: Comprehensive plan must be reviewed at least every 5 years.

sections.title: Detailplaneering
sections.body: Detailed plan – site-specific planning defining building rights, land use, public space.

sections.title: Avalik kaasamine
sections.body: Public participation requirements for detailed plans.

sections.title: Avalik väljapanek
sections.body: Public display of detailed plan – minimum 30 days.

sections.title: Vaidlustamise õigus
sections.body: Right to challenge adopted plan – 30 days from publication to file appeal to halduskohus.
